Name: Playable Piano - Controller Edition
Author: RexTempestas01
Description:
[b][size=5]Playable Piano - Controller Support[/size]
[/b]
[b][size=4]📖 About[/size][/b]
[size=4]This is a [color=#00ff00]-controller support update-[/color] for Mushroomy's "Playable Piano" mod. It adds the ability to control the MIDI playback menu using a game controller.[/size]

[size=4][b]⌨️ HOW TO USE[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=4]Sit on a piano: Right-click[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Open the piano menu: Left click / X / Y (controller)[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Close menu: Escape / Right click / B (controller)[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Stand up: Right click / B (controller) / Move with arrows or joystick[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Play MIDI files: Open menu > Play Track > Select song[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Free play (keyboard only): Open menu > Freeplay > Press keys Z-X-C-V-B etc.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Add your own MIDI files: Put .mid files in Mods/Playable_Piano/assets/songs/[/size][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Note:[/size][/b][size=4] [/size][size=4]For multiplayer sessions, all players must have the .mid song files placed in their respective "assets/songs" folder. The mod does not transmit audio or MIDI data between players; it only sends a signal to play a specific file, which must exist locally on each player's computer.[/size]

[size=4][b]🎹 Play Mode (Keyboard Only):[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Lower octave: Z, S, X, D, C, V, G, B, H, N, J, M[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Upper octave: Q, W, E, R, T, Y, U, I[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Lower octave mode: Left Control[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Normal octave mode: Left Shift[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Upper octave mode: Tab [/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/Vaq2Hfp.png[/img][/size]


[b][size=4]🆗 Compatibilty[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 on Linux/macOS/Windows.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Works in single player, and (mostly) in split-screen mode.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Works in Multiplayer, if both Players have the Mod installed, and the corresponding Soundfile for an Instrument[/size][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[b][size=4]🎮  What was changed[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4]Controller support for MIDI playback menu[/size][/*]
[*][color=#6aa84f][size=4]X / Y (Xbox)[/size][/color][size=4] / [/size][color=#3c78d8][size=4]Square (PlayStation)[/size][/color][size=4] → Open piano menu[/size][/*]
[*][color=#6aa84f][size=4]B (Xbox) [/size][/color][size=4]/ [/size][color=#3c78d8][size=4]Circle (PlayStation)[/size][/color] [size=4]→ Close menu / Cancel[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#ff7700]Escape[/color][color=#ffffff] / [/color][color=#ff7700]Right Click[/color][/size][size=4] → Same functions (unchanged)[/size][/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]❌  What was NOT changed[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4]Free Play mode (keyboard only)[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Click detection[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Playback controls[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Transitions[/size][/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]✔️ Original Features (Still work the same)[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4]Play Dark Piano and Upright Piano[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]MIDI file playback[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Free play mode (keyboard)[/size][/*]
[/list]
